== plan
frame #stoich_window
 flow #stoich_titlebar
  label '{stoich.title}'
  drop-down #stoich_plan_select <plan_surface>
  empty-widget
  sprite-button [utility/clock] <open_log>
  sprite-button [utility/preset] <open_settings>
  sprite-button [utility/close] <window_close>
 frame #stoich_inner
  flow #stoich_content
   flow #stoich_plan_header
    frame
     button '{stoich.capture}' <fac_capture>
     button '{stoich.new-factory}' <fac_new>
     button '{stoich.new-recipe}' <fac_new_recipe>
     button '{stoich.new-sink}' <fac_new_sink>
     button '{stoich.void-button}' <fac_boundary>
     button '{stoich.import-button}' <fac_boundary>
     empty-widget
     button '{stoich.statistics}' <open_stats>
     empty-widget
     sprite-button [utility/export] <fac_export_all>
     sprite-button [utility/import] <fac_import>
     sprite-button [utility/trash] <fac_clear_plan>
     empty-widget
     label '{stoich.status-EXACT}'
   flow #stoich_plan_problems
   flow #stoich_plan_main
    flow #stoich_plan_table_box
     flow
      label '{stoich.filter}'
      textfield <plan_filter>
      checkbox '{stoich.hide-ok}' <plan_hide_ok>
     flow #stoich_plan_rows
      scroll-pane #stoich_plan_pane
       table
        empty-widget
        label '{stoich.col-name}' ~{stoich.col-name-tooltip}
        label '{,{stoich.col-recipe}, (,/min,)}' ~{stoich.col-recipe-tooltip}
        label '{stoich.col-copies}' ~{stoich.col-copies-tooltip}
        label '{stoich.col-to-build}' ~{stoich.col-to-build-tooltip}
        empty-widget
        empty-widget
        sprite [item/plastic-bar]
        flow
         label 'Plastic bar' ~{,{stoich.per-copy},
,-14.2k/min [fluid=water]
-8267.9/min [fluid=crude-oil]
-1378/min [fluid=steam]
-755.6/min [item=coal]
+960/min [item=plastic-bar]}
        flow
         sprite-button [fluid/water] <plan_item>
         sprite-button [fluid/crude-oil] <plan_item>
         sprite-button [fluid/steam] <plan_item>
         sprite-button [item/coal] <plan_item>
         label '→'
         sprite-button [item/plastic-bar] <plan_item>
        flow
         button '−' <plan_copies>
         label '1' ~{,{stoich.shortage-tooltip,0,1,0,100},
,{stoich.surplus-tooltip,1}}
         button '+' <plan_copies>
         label '{stoich.copies-of,0}' ~{,{stoich.shortage-tooltip,0,1,0,100},
,{stoich.surplus-tooltip,1}}
        label '✓' ~{,{stoich.shortage-tooltip,0,1,0,100},
,{stoich.surplus-tooltip,1}}
        empty-widget
        flow
         sprite-button [utility/rename_icon] <fac_edit>

         sprite-button [utility/trash] <fac_delete>
